_comment: Source-of-truth for the auto-generated Workflow Index table in reference.md (#1289). Inclusion criterion (#1466): every workflow file under workflows/ is listed here, except reference.md (generated output, not a workflow). generate-reference.mjs fails if a workflows/*.md file is missing from this list, so new workflows must be added on creation. Order = display order. Each entry must reference a real file under workflows/.

workflows.purpose: CLI build, startup command, output parsing, error recovery
PR display, menu rendering, input parsing, informational questions
Orchestrate actionable PR resolution and issue list browsing
Code review gate for existing PR updates
Shared multi-agent review-dispatch template (consumed by both review workflows)
Issue reply triage and dismiss handler
Operationalizes the 7/14/30-day follow-up cadence for waiting-on-maintainer PRs
Draft a status comment on the linked issue after an own PR closed unmerged (#1863)
Acknowledge or reply to maintainer notes left on recently merged PRs, one per thanks-only repo group (#1861)
Re-review the changes and answer the questions on PRs the user reviewed after the author pushed or replied, via review-panel and draft-review-post (#1857)
Plan-phase review convergence loop — design critique before any code is written (companion to pre-commit-review)
Distill per-repo contribution guidelines from merged/closed PR feedback (#867)
Manual edit path for stored per-repo guidelines (load → edit → store, no extraction)
